about: Labelled TUNING sample for the chat 'looks like a bug' suggestion classifier (slack-messages-to-bug-reports-2026-10-05 P-007). The classifier's features and threshold are adjusted against this file only; chat-bug-suggest-holdout.json is the frozen measurement. Same labelling rule as the holdout: bug=true means the author reports that software misbehaves for them. Self-authored by su-dab96471, 2026-10-06.
